title_zh: 女團排練無聊就跳舞？路過鏡子必照！
title_en: Girl group member admits she dances out of boredom at rehearsals 😂
caption_zh: 排練唱歌太無聊，直接自己跳舞找樂子😂 女團路過鏡子全員必停下來整理儀容，這個魔力太真實了吧！
caption_en: Too bored at concert rehearsals so she just… started dancing 😂 And apparently every girl group member is physically unable to walk past a mirror without stopping — too relatable!

title_zh: 第一次吃減重粽！表情根本藏不住😂
title_en: Trying a 'Diet Zongzi' for the First Time — Can't Hide the Reaction 😂
caption_zh: 第一次挑戰減重粽，說好沒味道要沾糖，結果忘記沾😂表情管理完全失敗，觀眾全都看穿了哈哈哈！
caption_en: First time trying a 'diet zongzi' — no filling, no seasoning, supposed to dip in sugar… but she forgot 😂 Facial expressions said it all!

title_zh: 香菜冰心粽挑戰！裡面真的有香菜😱
title_en: Cilantro Ice Dumpling Challenge – They Can't Believe It's Real
caption_zh: 香菜花生冰心粽登場💀 打開的瞬間全員崩潰，哥直接說「太好了，那就是你的！」😂 你敢吃嗎？
caption_en: A cilantro & peanut ice-filled rice dumpling appears and the whole crew loses it 😂 Would YOU eat this?

caption_zh: 「誰會在吵架時假哭來獲得優勢？」成員互相指認超好笑，還有人65歲被要求點兒童餐😂 這題太犀利了！
caption_en: 'Who fake-cries during arguments to gain the upper hand?' Members immediately start pointing fingers — and then someone gets roasted for looking young enough to order a kids' meal at 65 😂

title_zh: 誰會把浣熊當貓帶回家？😂
title_en: Who Would Bring a Raccoon Home Thinking It's a Cat?
caption_zh: 這題太荒唐了吧！貓過敏還要帶浣熊回家？笑死😂 #猜猜我是誰
caption_en: The most chaotic 'who would' question ever — raccoon as a pet cat?? 😂 The laughter says it all.
